title: TechScript
tagline: A modern programming language and developer ecosystem built from the ground up.
description: TechScript is a long-term programming language project combining modern language design, developer productivity, performance, and clean syntax into a complete programming ecosystem with its own compiler, bytecode VM, standard library, and package manager.
problem: Most modern programming languages are either overly complex, hard to extend, or lack a integrated developer-first toolchain.
solution: Built in Rust from scratch, TechScript features a custom Lexer, Parser, AST Generator, Stack-based VM, Bytecode compiler, Standard library, and Package manager foundation.
highlights: Custom Lexer & Parser producing strict AST
Future LLVM backend & Language Server (LSP) roadmap
